title: Construction and coordinate denominator clearing for a reduced generic map
statement: Let A and B be commutative rings with B an A-algebra. Let K be a field with an A-algebra structure, K' a field with compatible K- and A-algebra structures, r a natural number, and L_j fields with K'-algebra structures for j in Fin(r). Fix a K'-algebra equivalence e from the quotient of (K tensor_A B) tensor_K K' by its nilradical onto the product of the L_j. Here the nilradical is the ideal of nilpotent elements. For every commutative A-algebra R with compatible map R to K' making K' a fraction field of R, and for all R-algebra structures on L_j compatible with R to K' to L_j, there exists an R-algebra homomorphism f from the quotient of B tensor_A R by its nilradical to the product of the L_j. Call f compatible when for every b in B its value on the class of b tensor 1 is e of the class of (1 tensor b) tensor 1. This f is compatible and for every j and z in L_j there exist a nonzero a in R and an element x of the source with algebraMap(R,L_j)(a) times z = f(x)_j. No module-finiteness or Noetherian hypothesis is required.

proof.text: Tensor associativity and commutation identify B tensor_A K' with (K tensor_A B) tensor_K K'. The map B tensor_A R to this generic algebra followed by the quotient and e kills every nilpotent, because a product of fields is reduced. Thus it factors through the source reduction, giving f and the pure-tensor identity. For z in L_j, apply e inverse to the vector supported at j with value z. Every element of B tensor_A K' is a finite sum of pure tensors. Write their K' coefficients as fractions over R, multiply the finitely many nonzero denominators, and lift the resulting numerator to B tensor_A R. Passing to the quotient gives a*z = f(x)_j. The product denominator is nonzero: R embeds in its fraction field K'. Empty sums use denominator 1. If r is zero the coordinate assertion is vacuous.

theorem exists_generic_product_map_denominators
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    (B : Type v) [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra A K]
    (K' : Type (max u v)) [Field K'] [Algebra K K'] [Algebra A K']
    [IsScalarTower A K K']
    (r : ℕ) (L : Fin r → Type (max u v)) [∀ j, Field (L j)]
    [∀ j, Algebra K' (L j)]
    (e :
      letI := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra (R := K) (A := K ⊗[A] B) (B := K')
      (((K ⊗[A] B) ⊗[K] K') ⧸
        nilradical ((K ⊗[A] B) ⊗[K] K')) ≃ₐ[K'] (∀ j, L j))
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Algebra A R] [Algebra R K']
    [IsScalarTower A R K'] [IsFractionRing R K']
    [∀ j, Algebra R (L j)] [∀ j, IsScalarTower R K' (L j)] :
    letI := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra (R := A) (A := B) (B := R)
    ∃ f : ((B ⊗[A] R) ⧸ nilradical (B ⊗[A] R)) →ₐ[R] (∀ j, L j),
            (∀ b : B, f (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (b ⊗ₜ[A] (1 : R))) =
              e (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[A] b) ⊗ₜ[K] (1 : K')))) ∧
            (∀ j (z : L j), ∃ a : R, a ≠ 0 ∧
              ∃ x, algebraMap R (L j) a * z = f x j)
